tasks.command: $jdk = Get-ChildItem (Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'jdks') -Directory -Filter 'jdk-25*' | Sort-Object { [version]($_.Name -replace '^jdk-', '') } -Descending | Select-Object -First 1; if (-not $jdk) { throw 'JDK 25 not found under LOCALAPPDATA\jdks. Install JDK 25 first.' }; $env:JAVA_HOME = $jdk.FullName; $env:Path = (Join-Path $env:JAVA_HOME 'bin') + ';' + $env:Path; .\mvnw.cmd spring-boot:run
